sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु तम् रामम् सम्रब्धो वाहिनी पतिः ।वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कुशलम् ततो मौनम् उपागमत् ॥६-१७-३०॥।।
transliteration: evam uktvā tu tam rāmam samrabdho vāhinī patiḥ ।vākyajño vākya kuśalam tato maunam upāgamat ॥6-17-30॥।।

translations.english: The chief of the army (Sugriva) who knew how to speak appropriately having submitted in that manner to Rama who was adept in expression remained silent.
